verdict.rationale: ADK's own docs show an agent defined in a few lines of Python (name, model, instruction, tools list), and the repo documents custom functions as tools defined directly in code. However, the few-lines example uses a prebuilt tool (google_search), and nothing shows custom tools being typed or schema-derived. missing for 10: evidence of typed tool signatures or schema generation from type hints, a concise custom-function tool code example, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define an agent with typed custom tools in a few lines of code

citations.quote:
agent = Agent(
    name="researcher",
    model="gemini-flash-latest",
    instruction="You help users research topics thoroughly.",
    tools=[google_search],
)
Utilize pre-built tools, custom functions, OpenAPI specs, MCP tools or integrate existing tools to give agents diverse capabilities
Define agent logic, tools, and orchestration directly in Python for ultimate flexibility, testability, and versioning.
